answer: A concrete defense is randomized liveness probing with network-diversity scoring. At unpredictable moments the protocol pings each identity through a fresh relay and demands a signed reply within seconds, stamped with peer address and round-trip time. A farm of clones tends to answer from one host or a narrow block, and its probes trace a tight spiral of identical routes. Honest agents show a broad terrace of addresses and variable latency from their own region, paths that drift like a long voyage instead of converging. When diversity falls below the cohort median, the account is throttled.
